agent_registration.entry_point: Implement phase 2 of the Mem0 memory layer: TOI and OTOI as standing terms, verified on every turn, governing learned-memory retention via TOI `privacy.retention`.
agent_registration.scope: Add TOI/OTOI loading, verification, honoring, and retention-based memory gating to the NLT Coding Agent MVP. New modules under mvp/src/toi/, runner integration, /api/memories/toi upload route, tests, spec, and governance records. No new npm dependency (toi/otoi already in lockfile).
capabilities_self_reported: Repository governance and agent configuration inspection
GitHub feature branch and pull request creation
Agent session registration, handoff, and review records
known_limitations: Real TOI/OTOI behaviour with the owner's local .toi/.otoi files not verified end-to-end
NLT_TOI_PUBKEY and NLT_OTOI_SHA256 not set in any environment (TOI verification unavailable until owner sets them)
Home-directory default paths for .toi/.otoi when ASFDK_*_PATH is unset not owner-confirmed
